residual: 10*log10(sum((superdough - rust)^2) / sum(superdough^2)) over every sample of every channel, no alignment search

reasons: no testable stem: every pair aliased or without fast-attack notes

rules.peakDb: max(0.1, 2 x worst |peak delta|, golden or twin), as self
rules.lufsDb: max(0.05, 2 x worst |LUFS delta|, golden or twin), as self
rules.bandMeanDb: max(0.1, 2 x worst |band mean delta| or twin band p95), as self
